task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the factorial of the last digit in a given number.
specification_response:
method FactorialOfLastDigit(n: int) returns (fact: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The returned value fact is equal to the factorial of the last digit of n
- The last digit of n is between 0 and 9
- fact is the factorial of that last digit
